subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery files, or may the migration delete them on the first cleanup cycle?
rationale: Config backups can be the user's only recovery copies, so silently deleting shipped rollback files is a compatibility decision that should not be inferred from an external PR.

options.title: Preserve Legacy Recovery Points
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamp retention set.

options.title: Accept Timestamp-Only Cleanup
options.body: Allow the first maintenance cycle to prune old numbered backups in exchange for a clean timestamp-only scheme.

options.title: Keep Numbered Ring
options.body: Reject timestamped names for now and keep the shipped numbered backup contract documented and tested.

recommendation.title: Preserve Legacy Recovery Points
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to keep existing `.bak.N` files through migration or convert them into the new bounded timestamp retention set.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest visible config backup/recovery history and prior review routing for the legacy-backup product choice.
